## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION and SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND confirm risk appetite while broad sector participation supports the call.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION is falling. Credit caveat: HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND yet the HYG/LQD signal flags rising credit stress; commodity/energy strength via XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND is another tailwind.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-favorable. UUP (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY showing dollar strength, TLT (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND steady, and SPY/TLT rising (1W: +1.48%) RECOVERY points to modest equity preference over bonds.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and energy leading: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and XLU (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND are strong; Tech lagging but showing a short-term bounce: XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY. Style: Cyclicals/value showing relative strength versus growth.

5. US vs Global?
US leadership with SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND; EM catching up via EEM (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND; China FXI (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -1.35%) RECOVERY still lagging.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative flows present but selective: IWM (1W: +1.95% | 1M: -1.19%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: +4.44% | 1M: -10.96%) RECOVERY show rotation into smaller/theme names, while IBIT (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -24.83%) RECOVERY remains volatile.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity strength led by energy and industrial metals: CPER (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND, and GLD (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +5.64%) ABOVE TREND. Silver is choppy: SLV (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy robust: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed signals: breadth (9/11) and falling VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION plus SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) support RISK-ON. Divergences are present but limited: multiple RECOVERY patterns (EWJ, ARKK, SLV, VXX) indicate short-term mismatches rather than a major regime break.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/energy and EM exposure given leadership in XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to stretched/volatile thematic names and monitor XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY for follow-through. Bonds neutral-to-supportive with TLT (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND, XLU (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLP (1W: -1.48% | 1M: +6.61%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND, TAN (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +14.39%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND; SLV (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) RECOVERY is high variance.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), SPY/TLT spread (watch 1W momentum and ties to SPY 1M trend), XLK/XLF ~2.0 as growth vs value pivot reference.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. XLE, XLU and cyclicals showing relative strength while XLK is in RECOVERY; key risk is rising credit-stress signal (HYG/LQD) and several 1W/1M RECOVERY divergences to monitor.
